GameOver.gr
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is arguably one of the most legendary titles in gaming history, having been highly influential and revolutionary upon its original release. This excellent remake completely modernises the visuals while introducing numerous quality-of-life improvements, offering the perfect opportunity for older gamers to relive the masterpiece that is Ocarina of Time and for newer generations to experience first-hand how a game that is almost 30 years old can still resonate with players today.

The magic has been preserved for a new generation. It is an effortless recommendation: a wonderful experience, a captivating history lesson, and just all-around brilliant.

SECTOR.sk
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time proves that truly timeless game design can remain just as enjoyable nearly 30 years later. Its enchanting world, memorable characters, clever puzzles and excellent dungeons are brought to life through beautiful visuals and an outstanding soundtrack. Unnecessary loading screens, limited voice acting and the inability to complete side quests after the ending are disappointing omissions, but they do little to diminish what is one of the most joyful gaming experiences of the year.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Nov 4, 2026
90
Games.cz
Ocarina of Time proves why it has become one of the most important gaming classics. The full-fledged remake not only gives it a beautiful new look, but above all removes a number of period compromises and sensitively adjusts the controls and some puzzles. At the same time, it does not lose the original charm or the clearly guided adventure structure. It is fascinating to watch how the first 3D Zelda learns from its younger followers without trying to be modern at all costs. Some archaic elements and a slower pace remind us of how much time has passed, but otherwise it is an exceptionally well-made journey.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Nov 4, 2026

RPG Site
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake feels designed for new players first and foremost, letting new generations see what made us fall in love with it back in the day, and in that regard, it succeeds with flying colors. While some decisions and directions in this remake may keep me from reaching for it again anytime soon, Ocarina of Time is a classic tale and remains a standout among the pantheon of the Zelda titles, and this remake is a great showing of why, even with its blemishes.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
